extDesc.message: Automatically save what matters from your ChatGPT, Gemini and Claude chats to your own Mem0 account.

tipManual.message: Click to save the last exchange

authApikeyMcp.message: API key on the MCP server (no OAuth — works even when Mem0's client registration is down)

apiKeyLabel.message: Mem0 API key (stored only in this browser)

userIdLabel.message: User ID (required) — memories are saved under this user_id

modeManual.message: Manual — only when I click “Save to Mem0”

redactLabel.message: Hide obvious secrets (API keys, tokens, card numbers) before sending

privacy.message: What is sent: only the question and answer you save, plus site, conversation ID and URL, directly to Mem0. Nothing goes anywhere else.

needUser.message: Set your User ID in Settings.

secAccountDesc.message: How the extension talks to your Mem0 account.

secUserDesc.message: Every memory is saved under this user. Use the same ID you use in other Mem0 integrations to keep everything together.

secCaptureDesc.message: Choose when conversations are saved and on which sites. The app_id identifies the source in Mem0.

diagNoTab.message: The extension is not active in this tab. Open chatgpt.com, gemini.google.com or claude.ai in Edge and reload the page.

secFilterDesc.message: Instructions sent with every conversation telling Mem0 what is worth remembering. Leave empty to let Mem0 decide on its own.

defaultInstructions.message: Extract only durable facts about the user: preferences, opinions, personal and professional details, projects, decisions, goals and life context. Ignore calculations, greetings, one-off questions, general trivia, generic content from the assistant's answers and any fact that is not about the user. When the user changes a preference or decision, record the new one making clear it replaces the previous one.

tipNothing.message: Mem0 found nothing worth remembering in this conversation

errNotConnected.message: Not connected to Mem0: open Settings and click Connect

errUnauthorized.message: Mem0 rejected the sign-in: connect again

errClientInvalid.message: Mem0 no longer recognizes this extension's sign-in (the client registration was dropped on the server). Open Settings and click Connect to register a new client.

errDcrUnavailable.message: The Mem0 server is refusing new client registrations (HTTP $1). Use an API key (MCP or REST) in Settings in the meantime.

errNeedUserLog.message: Set your User ID in Settings

consentHeading.message: Before you start: what this extension does with your data

consentDesc.message: This extension reads the last question and the last answer of the conversation that is open on chatgpt.com, gemini.google.com and claude.ai, and sends what you choose to YOUR Mem0 account.

consentItem1.message: The developer never receives your data: everything goes straight from your browser to your own Mem0 account.

consentItem2.message: The API key or access token you authorize stays only in your browser (chrome.storage.local).

consentItem3.message: No data is used for advertising, analytics or sharing with third parties, beyond the Mem0 service you chose.

consentAccept.message: I have read and agree: the last question and answer may be sent to my Mem0 account, and nothing is sent to the developer.

consentRequired.message: You need to accept above before connecting and before saving conversations.

consentNeed.message: Accept the data policy in the settings to send to Mem0.

consentOff.message: Without consent, nothing is sent to Mem0.
